name: What is the restucco process?

acceptedAnswer.text: The restucco process typically begins with an inspection and preparation of the existing surface. This often involves cleaning, repairing minor damage, and ensuring proper adhesion. For a full restucco, the old stucco may be removed, or a new wire lath and paper backing can be installed directly over the existing surface. Multiple layers of stucco, including a scratch coat, brown coat, and finish coat, are then applied. Each layer requires proper drying time before the next is applied, ensuring a durable and attractive finish.
acceptedAnswer.description: The restucco process involves surface preparation, applying new wire lath and paper backing if needed, and then applying multiple stucco layers, each with proper drying time.
